title: Evo-Memory: Benchmarking LLM Agent Test-time Learning with Self-Evolving Memory
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith. The only tangentially related component is a philosophy sub-task from the MMLU-Pro benchmark, but no specific results or analysis about religious topics within this sub-task are provided.
